instruction: Turn back from the place you are standing, you will find three chairs on the left side, now keep moving forward, on the right side you will find piano table, and a chair that is placed in front of the glass window, now go near the chair, and in front of that chair, you will find a room with two open doors, enter into the room, there you will find a table and a chair, on the left side you will find a mirror on the wall, now go and stand next to the chair, that will be your final destination.
